items.title: Bank rate increased to 4% - November 2026 Monetary Policy Summary and Minutes
items.summary: The Bank of England’s Monetary Policy Committee is responsible for making decisions about Bank Rate.
items.why: Bank of England changes monetary policy, raising the Bank Rate to 4%.

items.title: Joint Statement of the Government of Canada and the Bank of Canada on the Renewal of the Monetary Policy Framework
items.summary: The Government and the Bank agree that monetary policy must work to promote the economic and financial well-being of Canadians. We also agree that the best way monetary policy can do this is by keeping inflation low, stable and predictable, thereby protecting Canadians from large increases in the cost of living.
items.why: Five-year renewal of Canada's monetary policy framework agreed between central bank and government.

items.title: Designation of Prosegur Australia Pty Ltd under the Cash Distribution Framework Act 2026
items.summary: Media release number 2026-31: The RBA has today designated Prosegur Australia Pty Ltd (Prosegur Australia) (ACN 004 247 358) under the Cash Distribution Framework Act 2026 (the Act).
items.why: RBA formally designates major cash distributor Prosegur under the Cash Distribution Framework Act 2026.

items.title: Regulatory thresholds set to shift to automatic increases
items.summary: Proportionality is set to be improved for firms as over 100 regulatory thresholds could be automatically increased periodically.
items.why: Regulator changing rules to automatically increase over 100 regulatory thresholds.

items.title: Coinbase gets full US trust charter
items.summary: Crypto exchange Coinbase has secured final approval from US regulators for a national trust bank charter.
items.why: Major crypto exchange secures a national trust bank charter from US regulators.

items.title: Federal Reserve Board announces enforcement action against American Express Company to address, among other things, the firm’s failure to sufficiently detect and report certain suspicious activity related to money laundering
items.summary: Federal Reserve Board announces enforcement action against American Express Company to address, among other things, the firm’s failure to sufficiently detect and report certain suspicious activity related to money laundering
items.why: Fed enforcement action against major financial institution American Express over AML failures.

items.title: Standard Chartered Acquires Zodia Custody in Digital Assets Push
items.summary: Standard Chartered has signed definitive agreements to buy 100% of Zodia Custody, consolidating its institutional digital asset custody operations globally. The post Standard Chartered Acquires Zodia Custody in Digital Assets Push appeared first on The Fintech Times .
items.why: Standard Chartered acquires full ownership of institutional digital asset custodian Zodia Custody.

items.title: Binance says hackers used fake job interviews and AI tools in $6.3bn hack
items.summary: Binance says the $6.3 billion cyberattack it suffered last week was a sophisticated, multi-stage campaign that included fake job interviews, malicious software downloads and compromised AI tooling.
items.why: Binance discloses novel AI vectors and fake interviews behind massive $6.3 billion cyberattack.

items.title: FCA sets out rules for ESG rating providers
items.summary: The UK's Financial Conduct Authority has finalised new rules for ESG rating providers designed to raise standards and help investors to make better informed decisions.
items.why: FCA finalises new regulatory rules for ESG rating providers.

items.title: OppFi abandons purchase of BNC Bank
items.summary: Digital finance platform OppFi has withdrawn its applications buy a bank, claiming it has not had a meaningful opportunity to engage with regulators to address concerns about the deal.
items.why: OppFi withdrew its bank purchase application after regulatory engagement challenges.

items.title: Stripe Treasury launches in the UK
items.summary: Stripe, the programmable financial services company, today launched Stripe Treasury in the UK, enabling founders to manage money from the same Dashboard where they already accept payments, without navigating across separate providers.
items.why: Stripe expanded its embedded treasury banking product to the UK market.

items.title: Block faces $765m DoJ settlement
items.summary: Block has reached a preliminary settlement with the US Department of Justice that could see Jack Dorsey's firm pay $764 million over money laundering failures.
items.why: Major preliminary $764M DOJ anti-money laundering settlement facing Block.

items.title: Finra fines Webull $4.2m for AML and best execution failures
items.summary: Digital investing platform Webull has been fined $4.2 million by US regulators for failing to roll out reasonably designed programmes for anti-money laundering, identity theft prevention and best execution.
items.why: FINRA fined broker Webull $4.2 million for anti-money laundering and best execution failures.

items.title: Monzo eyes fresh funding at £7.5bn valuation - FT
items.summary: After a takeover by Brazil's Nubank failed to materialise, Monzo is exploring a new funding round that would value the UK digital bank at around £7.5 billion, according to the Financial Times.
items.why: Major neobank funding round and failed takeover attempt revealed.

items.title: Canada's real-time payments system launches
items.summary: Following years of delays, Canada's Real-Time Rail (RTR) payments system has finally launched.
items.why: Significant launch of long-delayed national real-time payments infrastructure in Canada.

items.title: PNC launches stablecoin payments for corporate clients
items.summary: PNC Bank is working with Coinbase to make incoming stablecoin payments available to its corporate and institutional clients.
items.why: Major US bank integrates stablecoin rails for corporate payments via Coinbase partnership.

items.title: TasWater bosses blame regulator for 'miscalculation' that saw massive bill hikes
items.summary: Senior leaders at Tasmania's water utility privately blamed the state's economic regulator for an "error" that threatened to cost customers tens of thousands of dollars, documents show.
items.why: Documents reveal economic regulator miscalculation caused massive water bill hikes for customers.

items.title: Starling Bank CEO to step down after just two years, reports say
items.why: Unexpected early departure of top executive at a major UK digital bank.

items.title: David Jones stores tipped to close as retailer enters administration
items.summary: Customers are left wondering as the retailer calls in administrators while it struggles to pay its rent.
items.why: Major retail chain enters voluntary administration, threatening widespread store closures.

items.title: Paraguay's president tangled up in Ueno banking crisis
items.summary: Paraguay's president has stepped down after the collapse of Ueno Bank plunged the country into a political crisis.
items.why: Paraguayan president resigns following major bank collapse and political crisis.

items.title: Musk axes Tesla's Cybertruck in favour of self-driving taxis
items.summary: Elon Musk says Tesla will wind down Cybertruck production in mid-2027 after years of persistently weak sales for a futuristic model once touted as a rival to legacy pickup trucks.
items.why: Unexpected corporate strategy pivot by a major public company to axe a primary product line.

items.title: The questionable sales tactics prompting people to switch their super
items.summary: Unqualified and unlicensed telemarketers are targeting Australians to switch their superannuation savings into riskier schemes. This has prompted the corporate regulator to threaten the licences of financial advice firms that use these "lead generators".
items.why: Regulator threatens adviser licences over predatory cold-call superannuation switching tactics.
